scope: Isolated fixture project; no canonical source or mandatory model registration
pathSemantics: Frozen authority paths retain their original meaning. nativePath is relative to project/; historicalSource records original provenance and is not a portable build requirement. repositoryPath is the delivery location. Authority documents are preserved historical records, not current acceptance claims.
excludedFromCheckpointScope: generated production artifacts or SDK release bindings
baselineScope: Exact isolated source inputs have an independently audited finite positive baseline; mutation sensitivity, full restoration and broader integration remain unaccepted.
